lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits. These clusters are arranged in a semi-regular grid where the spatial frequency decreases and cluster diameter increases along the anterior-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the longitudinal ridges. The primary high-intensity blobs are positioned within the rectangular grid cells formed by these vertical bands and the horizontal carinae.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, each characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high-luminance highlights on the superior edge and deep-shadowed regions on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, located in the upper right of the frame, contains a sparse distribution of approximately 6-8 discrete high-luminance blobs.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, high-chroma yellow features with elongated morphology are visible in the water column adjacent to the head and pectoral fin regions.
